provenance.target_meaning: Simulated analyst escalation after investigation; never proof of crime

independent_verification.scope: Independent SQL checks executed in Docker against persisted predictions; AP and Brier are recomputed without sklearn.

evidence.sql: SELECT count(*)=8000 AND count(DISTINCT alert_id)=8000 AND count(DISTINCT customer_id)=8000 FROM raw.source
SELECT count(*)=1000 AND count(DISTINCT alert_id)=1000 FROM results.test_predictions

checks.name: Prediction IDs belong only to held-out dates

evidence.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM results.test_predictions p LEFT JOIN raw.source r USING(alert_id) WHERE r.alert_id IS NULL OR CAST(r.alert_time AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP '2025-12-17' OR CAST(r.alert_time AS TIMESTAMP)>=TIMESTAMP '2026-02-05')

checks.name: Scores and frozen decisions are consistent

evidence.sql: SELECT count(*)=1000 AND bool_and(isfinite(escalation_score) AND escalation_score BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND isfinite(frozen_threshold) AND frozen_threshold BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND review_recommended=(escalation_score>=frozen_threshold) AND split='test') AND count(DISTINCT frozen_threshold)=1 AND count(DISTINCT model_id)=1 FROM results.test_predictions

SELECT count(*)=1000 AND bool_and(p.confirmed_escalation=r.confirmed_escalation AND p.customer_id=r.customer_id AND p.alert_time=CAST(r.alert_time AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND p.label_available_at=CAST(r.label_available_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) FROM results.test_predictions p JOIN raw.source r USING(alert_id)

checks.name: Selected model and threshold match scored predictions

evidence.sql: SELECT count(*)=1 AND bool_and(m.model=p.model_id AND m.frozen_validation_threshold=p.frozen_threshold) FROM results.model_comparison m CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT model_id,frozen_threshold FROM results.test_predictions) p WHERE selected_by_validation

checks.name: Selection uses best candidate validation score

evidence.sql: SELECT count(*)=1 AND bool_and(validation_average_precision=(SELECT max(validation_average_precision) FROM results.model_comparison WHERE model IN ('Prevalence dummy','Logistic regression','Random forest'))) FROM results.model_comparison WHERE selected_by_validation

SELECT (SELECT rows=4600 FROM results.split_audit WHERE split='train') AND (SELECT rows=1200 FROM results.split_audit WHERE split='validation') AND (SELECT rows=1000 FROM results.split_audit WHERE split='test') AND (SELECT CAST(latest_label_available AS TIMESTAMPTZ) FROM results.split_audit WHERE split='train') < (SELECT CAST(first_alert AS TIMESTAMPTZ) FROM results.split_audit WHERE split='validation') AND (SELECT CAST(latest_label_available AS TIMESTAMPTZ) FROM results.split_audit WHERE split='validation') < (SELECT CAST(first_alert AS TIMESTAMPTZ) FROM results.split_audit WHERE split='test') AND (SELECT max(label_available_at) FROM results.test_predictions)<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-03-07 00:00:00+00'

checks.name: Average precision independently recomputed from scored rows

evidence.sql: WITH score_groups AS (SELECT escalation_score,count(*) AS n,sum(confirmed_escalation) AS pos FROM results.test_predictions GROUP BY escalation_score), cumulative AS (SELECT pos,sum(pos) OVER(ORDER BY escalation_score DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS tp,sum(n) OVER(ORDER BY escalation_score DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS reviewed,sum(pos) OVER() AS positives FROM score_groups), recomputed AS (SELECT sum((pos::DOUBLE/positives)*(tp::DOUBLE/reviewed)) AS ap FROM cumulative) SELECT abs(recomputed.ap-m.test_average_precision)<1e-12 FROM recomputed CROSS JOIN results.model_comparison m WHERE m.selected_by_validation

checks.name: Brier score independently recomputed from scored rows

evidence.sql: SELECT abs((SELECT avg(power(escalation_score-confirmed_escalation,2)) FROM results.test_predictions)-test_brier_score)<1e-12 FROM results.model_comparison WHERE selected_by_validation

checks.name: Confusion matrix reconciles to saved predictions

evidence.sql: SELECT count(*)=1000 AND count(*) FILTER(WHERE review_recommended AND confirmed_escalation=1)=64 AND count(*) FILTER(WHERE review_recommended AND confirmed_escalation=0)=54 AND count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT review_recommended AND confirmed_escalation=1)=106 AND count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT review_recommended AND confirmed_escalation=0)=776 FROM results.test_predictions

fixed_10pct_test_capacity.interpretation: Same count of highest-ranked test alerts; separate from the frozen-threshold deployment evaluation

limitations: Labels are simulated analyst-escalation outcomes from a synthetic data generator; they are not evidence of crime, laundering or regulatory violations.
The experiment evaluates synthetic temporal generalization only. It has not been validated against real FCCM alerts or investigated outcomes.
Scores estimate the simulated target and have not been calibrated. Brier score is a diagnostic, not a calibration guarantee.
Features must be computed using information available at each alert time. This synthetic dataset supplies those features directly; production aggregation requires separate point-in-time controls.
The frozen threshold targets 10% review on validation. Future and test review rates can differ because score distributions drift or ties occur.
The fixed-capacity comparison ranks exactly 10% of test alerts, separately from deployment at the frozen threshold. Test curves are descriptive and did not select the model or threshold.
One unique synthetic customer per row avoids customer overlap. Real repeated-customer data needs customer-aware temporal evaluation.
Feature permutation is global post-hoc association on the test set, not a causal explanation or an explanation of a particular alert.
The five fresh cases have unknown outcomes. Their predicted scores demonstrate saved-model inference, not correct predictions.
Hyperparameters were specified before evaluation. The winning candidate was selected only by validation average precision; test outcomes were used for final reporting and interpretation.

ui_verification.scope: The running predictive dashboard, four metrics and four Plotly charts were visually inspected; explicit light chart text is readable. The SQL interface displayed all five fresh-case scores and their review decisions. The dashboard was left open.
